blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Advocacy and transport groups on Tuesday called for motorcycle taxi platform Move It to be held accountable for exceeding its authorized rider allocation, while urging regulators to protect the livelihoods of rider-partners affected by the company’s violations. The calls came after the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) imposed a P555.75-million penalty on Move It for maintaining 55,575 riders beyond its authorized limit. The board found that Move It had 73,321 active rider-partners as of May 2026, despite being authorized to maintain only 17,746 across Metro Manila, Cebu City and Cagayan de Oro.
